requirements.evidence: Aquarium Core 0.4.0 publishes bounded read-only diagnostics and local symbolic ActivityHistory: declared fixed event-code allowlists, generated IDs, UTC recording times, levels and numeric versions; default 500 retained events, 1 MiB JSON bound, explicit drop counts, atomic publication and cooperating-writer locks. Unknown root/event fields survive appends; future/corrupt records are refused. Typed export omits unknown extras. Aquarium Settings reviews/exports its app-start and notice-severity events without notice/error text, stacks, paths or library records. 38 Windows activity checks plus existing Core regression and Windows/Ubuntu CI pass. No automatic uploads, crash collection or cross-app adoption are claimed; broader shared logging/adapters remain open. FishNet 0.6.4 now adopts the same published Core 0.4 package, fixed app-start/error-notice kinds, 500 retained events, 16 pending-write cap, incomplete-session warning and explicit reviewed JSON export. Its 19 integration checks, existing media/conversion suites, native build and full Windows CI pass; public source, digests, version and 516-entry runtime verified.
